description: Recently recorded NYC real-property documents from the city's ACRIS master file (NYC Open Data): document type (e.g. DEED, MTGE), document date, recorded date, borough and document amount in USD. Not limited to commercial property, and it is the recording record, not a sales-price database. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

borough.description: Optional: manhattan, bronx, brooklyn, queens or staten island

docType.description: Optional ACRIS document type code, e.g. DEED or MTGE
